snippet.title: Canjin gameplay video -JUJU GAMES
snippet.description:
Before Vodou. Before the team grew. There was CANJIN.

One of our earliest passion projects—pitched to studios, dreamed up in long nights—but back then, it was just one or two of us. No real budget. No network. Just raw fire and ambition.

We shelved it, waiting for the day the stars would align.

Three years later, with a small grant in hand, we decided to dust it off. Under the codename Project Zangeto, Canjin was meant to be an Unreal Engine fighter-RPG, drenched in stylized combat and comic book energy. The story? A Marxist vigilante racing against curfew in the Badlands, trying to smuggle out a document that could liberate the people.

You can feel its DNA in Vodou today.

We’re not done with Canjin. One day, with the right support, it’ll rise again.

Until then—enjoy this rare slice of gameplay.
